request: Fix Taskboard worker launch for ROT-18: replace the competing Execute and Start agent actions with one preferred Start agent flow, keep the dedicated Worker page and kanban drag-to-in-progress launch behavior, and handle repositories with no initial commit so users are not blocked by the current raw validation error. Preserve existing uncommitted Taskboard work and verify the resulting UI and execution behavior.
message: The live ROT-8 worker now launches and uses the target repository Empirical harness, but Empirical fails before implementation with TRACKER_CREATE_MARKER_MISMATCH / TRACKER_CREATE_AMBIGUOUS because the existing Linear ticket ROT-8 is not durably attached and a duplicate ROT-19 gets created. Fix Taskboard's worker handoff so an existing originating tracker ticket is explicitly and unambiguously attached to the Empirical feature before material work begins, without creating a duplicate issue. Preserve the external-data trust boundary, support Linear/Jira/GitHub identifiers, keep provider lifecycle synchronization, and verify against the live ROT-8/ROT-19 incident.

lifecycle.riskRequest: Fix the missing native-thread lifecycle integration: when a Taskboard-provisioned issue thread completes or reports its final result, Taskboard must reconcile that thread back into its internal execution/tracker state and expose the completion rather than leaving the issue unchanged. Preserve tracker authority: do not automatically mark an external issue done unless the configured workflow explicitly allows it, but always record/link the provisioned thread and its completion outcome so ROT-18 no longer appears untouched after successful work.

sizeDecision.reason: Provider transitions, Empirical handoff requirements, and native-thread reconciliation are one lifecycle; splitting would again allow a launch to report success without proving the ticket update and harness gate.
